Activation without a network: the request code as text and a QR code, then a response file loaded, dropped or pasted. A response whose signature does not verify is rejected with its reason, never silently.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    **Drop-in.** `offline-request` (the request code, and a half-block QR wherever the whole screen fits with it) and `import-bundle <file | ->`.

    **Styled part.** `screens.offline_activation(kit, view)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `OfflineView` in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Node)">
    **Drop-in.** `offline-request` (`offlineRequestFlow`) prints the request code, with a QR code
    wherever the whole screen fits with it (`default`); `import-bundle <file>`
    (`importBundleFlow`) activates from the operator's file (`done`, `rejected-signature`).

    **Styled part.** `codeRows`, and the `qrLines` and `qrFits` primitives.

    **Headless.** None of its own: the request code is `client.core.deviceId` and the import
    `client.importBundle(jws)`.

    [Terminal (Node)](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/terminal-node/) has the adapter's options, the
    `--json` contract and the fallbacks.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    **Drop-in.** Off on iOS by default (`KitGateOptions(offlineActivation:)`); the drop-in's view arrives with UK-08's Mac pass.

    **Styled part.** Not drawn yet.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.offlineActivation(_:)`: a loaded file is not an activation until its signature verifies.

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
